notes.title: Small update 1.2.2
notes.content:
Fixed a bug with the level unlocks for level 120, put in some extra code to make sure that it retroactively fixes it for everyone. 
 Fixed a bug where if you deleted your data, your towers/buffs selection wouldn't change. An extra check has been put in to make sure you own the towers/buffs you have selected, if you do not, it resets your selection to default.
 Added in some cheat codes... but I'm not telling you what they are! :P

notes.title: Defend from Candyland! 1.2!
notes.content:
Greetings Defenders of Eden!

We are thrilled to announce the release of a major update for "Defend from Candyland!" bringing the game to version 1.2. This update includes a variety of new features, improvements, and enhancements to make your defense experience even more delightful and engaging.

What's New in Version 1.2?
New Interactive Tutorial

Learn from Dr. Dexter, one of the smartest trees, on how to best protect Candyland! Our new, interactive tutorial will guide you through all the essential mechanics and strategies, whether you're a new player or just need a refresher.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/c31796733a38948744722f69a53dcb73ae26f222.gif

Story Added

Immerse yourself in the sweet and adventurous story of Candyland. Discover the narrative behind the candy invasion as you help defend Eden from the unexpected attack. Engage with intriguing characters and uncover the mystery of why Candyland has turned sour. The fate of Eden lies in your hands!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/0bd613508d0ca8c62c07eb522e8ed7b2ecba26cb.gif

New Layouts for a Better Experience

We’ve revamped several key areas of the game to provide a smoother and more intuitive experience:

In-Game Menu
- New Design: The in-game menu has been completely redesigned for easier navigation and a more polished look.
  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/7815349fb755cb6bbddcc381cd13aee4ad1d1440.jpg

Main Menu
- Fresh Look: The main menu now features an updated layout to welcome you into the world of Candyland with style.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/36e40ebf8f34efc16fd19fdd58cd7cf0b8ef28fe.jpg

Current and Next Enemy Boards
- Enhanced Layouts: We've updated the current and next enemy boards to give you clearer insights into the upcoming challenges.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/f5a0d4a6e9c219951ba0528d0856962135d6dea1.png

New Shop Items

Two new items have been added to the shop, providing strategic advantages:

- Enemy Path Viewers: These items allow you to see enemy paths, helping you plan your defenses more effectively.

Other Improvements

- Updated Art Assets: Enjoy a more vibrant and colorful Candyland with updated textures and graphics.
- Repositioned Enemy Health Bars: We’ve repositioned enemy health bars for better visibility and tracking during intense battles.
- Better notifcations: We've added a better notificaiton board, with text, to tell you when you can't place a tree and why, rather than the old colour system.

---

We hope you enjoy all the new features and improvements in version 1.2. Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us, so please let us know your thoughts on this update.

Thank you for defending Eden, from Candyland, with us!

Stay sweet,
Michael "MI Pixel" Ingram

notes.title: 🎉 Steam Summer Sale + Upcoming Update! 🎉
notes.content:
Hey Eden Defenders!

We have some exciting news to share! Defend from Candyland! is now part of the Steam Summer Sale! You can grab the game and its art pack for just £2.68! This is the perfect time to dive into the sweet and strategic world of Candyland. 🍭🔥

But that's not all! We're thrilled to announce that new updates are on the way, bringing Defend from Candyland! to version 1.2! Here's a sneak peek at what's coming:


 Brand New User Interface: We've revamped the UI to make your gameplay experience smoother and more intuitive.
 In-Depth Tutorials: New tutorials will be added to help both new and experienced players master the game mechanics and strategies.
 Exciting Story: Immerse yourself in the sweet saga of Candyland with our newly added storyline!
 And more! 


Stay tuned for more details on the update, and in the meantime, take advantage of the Steam Summer Sale and spread the word! Your support and feedback are incredibly valuable to us.

Happy defending! 🛡️🍬

~ Michael "MI Pixel" Ingram

notes.title: Version 1.1.1
notes.content:
Heya everyone, Michael here.

So, this is a quick update with some bug fixes generally.
 
Fixed a bug where first time you loaded the game the "How To" loaded all pages at once.

Fixed a bug with the data deletion buttons not working properly. 

Fixed a bug where it would sometimes play the wrong music (If Halloween DLC was active when game loaded, it would load regular main menu music instead of Halloween DLC one).

As well as this, I have added in some new Halloween Art changes. Added in Halloween art for all of the buffs as well as the Tokens.

Have fun

notes.title: Large Art update!
notes.content:
Heya everyone, I have a large art update for you here! There is more to be done/being done but, as soo much of it is completed, I have released the major art update now. There is a new colour palette that has been created for the game and most of the sprites characters/towers/enemies have been re-drawn! There is more to be added but, what do you all think of this new art? Let me know! 

I will be modifying the Steam page and the Fandom.Wiki pages to include the new art at a later date as well. I want to try and complete the update within the game for yourselves first, then work on that afterwards :) 

Would love to hear any feedback you may have.

Enjoy!

Balance patch
You can now not face Flying Saucers on the endless level versions of levels that did not have flying saucers. 

Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where you couldn't see how many apples you had whilst in the shop.

UI Update
Added your current apples to the main menu screen, making it easier to see how many apples you have.

notes.title: Version 0.5.1
notes.content:
Heya everyone, another major update is here!

Characters

To start with, there is a new look coming to Defend from Candyland! There are a bunch of characters coming in and they will now show you around Eden and help you out. The new home screen now looks like this:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/ade102c1119e4f00d0ac8e05dfb822de7f3e6972.jpg

We have new characters, joining the old ones, to take you to different places. Along with this, we have created a Fandom.Wiki page here: Defend from Candyland! which currently has more details about the characters, more will be added to it soon! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/6589d6c3009ca5951c442a4ed3f50f6acf8b97ad.gif
Oracle Tree.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/8ceaa91b70ea386cacd1cf35ffe8cc6598ca2e2b.gif
Miss Applebee.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/2af6980b728bd3b5a86f93f91c25f844431d22fc.gif
Seargent Switch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/82ab4f34ad617a90f7707bb4b5ab2d7731d0da04.gif
Senorita Settings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/27d7febb1d667193561ca3257b7644b989d7bf45.gif
Monsiuer Morté.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/f6e1e723768f762afe68b7fb2adf111604a9c168.gif
Tiny Tia.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/63dabbec404298252eced2c5ba72cd9718c4d065.gif
Doctor Dexter.

Towers

We have a new tower joining the fray and that is, the Cattail sniper!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/97dd40e6ed8ed3a1e22efc3da8c9160cb71335ba.png

This tower can hit all enemies, has a lot of power and has he largest range of any tower so far! This should certainly help against all enemies! 

The Anti-Air Carrot Field also has an upgrade, the upgrade from Miss Applebee's shop now increases their fire power by 5 instead of 1. Take down those Flying Saucers!

Endless Mode

Endless Mode has had another update

The Endless Mode is now configurable, so, you can choose where you want the Spawning Jellies/Destination Trees to be! If however you leave it blank, Seargent Switch will randomly assign you between 1 & 3 of the Jellies/Trees.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/b730b5cd2413fb57ca506a5f6768bafd7caaa053.jpg

Speaking of Endless Mode, there is now an Endless Mode of each level in the game to unlock! You need to have gotten 3 Apples on the level, this will then allow you to compete in an Endless Version of that level for another high score and more apples! This change also brings a new look to the level select!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/05400727c1f1688d7ab31beebfc0fb93a7148e2d.jpg

Music

Arman Mkhitarian has created another track for Defend from Candyland! to replace the current battle music. The old battle music is still in the game, however, it will only play when your health is in the red! 

Tips

With the new characters, we now have Doctor Dexters Tips! If you pause the game, Doctor Dexter will pop up and give you a random tip about the game or its characters! 

Settings

In the settings menu, the ability to manually save has now been added, along with, the ability to change your cursor! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/278885b21d7449b315958c8e10d04c4170ca3d85.jpg

So, with that, get out there and Defend from Candyland!

notes.title: Version 0.5.0!
notes.content:
Greetings all, we have a new major update! 

This update is focused mainly around the "Endless Mode". There have been large improvements made to this. 

Endless Mode!

Endless mode has been changed to award Apples for certain achievements within it. So now, you can earn 1 apple for every 50 waves you defeat, at the same time, you can earn 2 apples for beating your own high score! With that being said, Endless Mode now records your High Score and saves it, so you can always challenge yourself to do better! (and be rewarded with apples for it too!)

Endless mode has also had some other changes. There are now random elements in play including, Spawning Jellies, Tree Bases, level layout, enemy waves and more! adding soo many more possibilities to the endless mode.

Of course, it's not just the Endless Mode that has had work done. 

Health Bars

The Health Bars that were added in, as a suggestion from current players, have now had a new look added to them! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/23b41f14cf89712c16e3b79ca64e61490364ae66.png

New Upgrade Icon placement!

As was suggested by ValdarakGaming, the upgrade icon now appears on the tree/tower you have selected when an upgrade is possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/5ca4698838d402e55a206bc9111be2df1bfae24c.png

Balances/Bug Fixes

Level 7 has had some extra Jelly Beans thrown into the Scenario, this is to allow a bit more time before the Gummy Bears and make the level a little easier. There was also a bug where the health bar wasn't displaying the health correctly, this has now been fixed!

notes.title: Version 0.4.5!
notes.content:
A new update is here! This update brings bug fixes, health bars and tower balances! So, let's go into this a little more!

Bug Fixes

A few bugs were reported which have now been fixed. Namely, the "Jelly Bro" and "Fruit Salad" achievement can now be attained without issue. Bug that prevented purchases unless you had MORE apples than required is now fixed. Bug with the UI displaying incorrect tower info, now fixed.

Health Bars

Players suggested that they would like to see enemy health bars. These have now been implemented, as soon as an enemy is damaged a health bar appears above them. Green is full health and it transitions to red to show damage.

Tower/Tree Balances

The Peashooters have had their upgrade price increased, as well as this, their range has been reduced. 

The Cherry Bomb upgrade from Miss Applebee is now an increase of 5 damage to each level, rather than 1. 

Thanks again everyone for the amazing feedback and bug reporting over on the Discord Server. If you see or think of anything else, let me know! 

Kind Regards

Michael

notes.title: Music and Tower Update!
notes.content:
After receiving feedback from multiple sources about the music, the amazing Arman Mkhitaryan of https://armanmkhitarian.weebly.com/ has made some new music for us. This replaces the previous menu music and game play music. Let us know what you think of this new music! 

As well as this, there was feedback about the towers stats not being quite balanced.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/5aec133d5dd3151351a4face3e2c49b9a5d3bbe8.png
Peashooter towers  have had their range, power and speed reduced! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/3c252c4414cba611a79fc0c6b3bc9adb7cd98ae4.png

Cherry Bomb towers have had their power and range increased. Their speed and cost however have been reduced. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/9f41312e36f02b2a2a1954b0382469fcecafb4b4.png

Anti Air Carrot Fields have had their attack increased as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549477/a82b2566d7d3f3c303937ad4a7d03c7c0114b7df.png

Links to our social media platforms and Discord have been added to the menu. This is to allow you easier access to provide feedback to us and ask any questions, as well as you to follow us and see what else is coming for Defend from Candyland! and any future games! 


A new Shop button has been added to the menu, this is because we are currently working on adding a shop to Defend from Candyland! This shop will accept the Apples you earn for completing the levels to award you pemenent benefits. Have any ideas of something you would like to see sold in the shop? Let us know!
